name: v5_rigspec
note: Frozen joint contract for versions/rebuild_v7_s2d.blend. Derived from reference/v4_rigspec.json with three measured deviations listed below. Stage 3 animates against these numbers, so they must not drift without a new rigspec.

fingers.layout: four 2-segment fingers fanned in the XZ plane below the palm, phi measured from -Z inside that plane

grab_point_note: centre of the 4 tip arc, 34 mm below the palm along the finger drop axis

deviations.why: with r 0.044 at z 0.725 the elbow ball topped out at 0.769; the reference's overall z max is 0.754 (part_4's tube). Dropping the elbow 16 mm puts the ball crown at 0.753 and leaves the wrist at 0.706 so the finger cluster keeps its height.

deviations.reference: four knuckles clustered in a 0.09 x 0.10 x 0.09 box, arrangement not resolvable from the 900 px views
deviations.ours: fan of four in the XZ plane at phi -45/-15/+15/+45 deg
deviations.why: a 90 deg ring about the wrist axis projected to only two prongs in front view, while reference/views_20261124/arm_front.png clearly shows four separated fingers fanning down-left. The XZ fan reproduces the four visible prongs and still closes as a two-sided grip for stage 3.

ring heights were fitted to the reference silhouette row by row off ref_front.png (z 0.50 -> -0.4349, 0.55 -> -0.4589, 0.60 -> -0.4877, 0.65 -> -0.4956); a mid-height bulge put 40 mm of extra leg in the silhouette and cost 0.9 points of front IoU
